meaning: Plan is sufficient to start bounded implementation. This is not implementation acceptance, actual remote authentication verification, device verification, or visual acceptance.
coverage: Normal first-launch login and account/settings navigation are separated from DEBUG capture fixtures and remote service success.

Actual supported AGC provider, iOS bundle configuration, simulator build, injectable behavior tests and actual remote verification are distinct deliverables; absent external configuration does not justify a production fake provider.
Reset-success/sign-in-failure, consumed code, purpose/email cooldown, local sign-out despite remote cleanup failure, local cleanup failure and failed deletion preservation are explicit.
AI defaults affect new memories; explicit settings save cancels old configuration requests and prevents stale writes; restored drafts retain their recorded choice.
Existing avatar/export/provider/key/consent/account isolation and offline behavior are retained; password reveal and stale errors have concrete parity requirements.
The new functional phase is bounded separately without resetting historical attempts, weakening old failures, claiming all 53 visual states, merging or archiving the incomplete change.

implementationClarifications.text: First launch means a clean normal installation/session store. Do not interpret this as forcing login on every launch or invalidating a valid persisted local/remote session.

Harmony has a configurable hosted AI adapter whereas iOS currently hardcodes hosted unavailability. The current Harmony gateway URL is also empty. Inventory this honestly; do not claim hosted parity or working hosted service from this authentication/settings milestone.

Official SDK availability and compile/link probe were reported by the implementation coordinator. This review did not execute or independently reproduce that probe; final review must inspect actual production linkage and current build evidence.

requiredLaterEvidence: current iOS build and runner provenance
normal-entry simulator flow and original login/account/settings screenshots
actual configured remote account verification or explicit unresolved external gap

sourceAudit.difference: Production default auth provider is unconfigured, so existing forms do not provide real remote login/register/reset/account deletion.
Stored AI enabled default and explicit settings-save changes are not propagated into new/current draft behavior.
Reset and subsequent login are one success/failure result; no accurate partial-success return to password login.
Remote sign-out failure can prevent local exit; the plan deliberately improves resilience. Harmony has similar ordering, so this is not exclusively an iOS omission.
Login/reset password cannot be revealed while entering.
Editing code/password leaves a stale error; only email edits clear it.

Hosted/default AI is always unavailable in iOS; Harmony selects an actual hosted adapter when configured. Both currently lack an enabled hosted production endpoint, so this does not prove a live service regression.

Login, account entry, avatar/reset, JSON/Markdown export, password management, delete/logout, five model presets, personal connection test, key deletion/consent and non-purchasable membership explanation already have iOS UI; do not recreate them as missing pages.

Authenticated screenshots skip login because the capture fixture installs identity, or because local identity persisted. Both clients intentionally hide remote password management for owner-local identity. Page absence in those screenshots is not proof that normal login/account routes are missing.
